brief: How to run a discovery call that closes — 6 questions to ask.

slots.title: Define what success looks like
slots.body: Ask prospects to describe their perfect end-state. This reveals priorities and aligns your solution to their exact goals. It also positions you as a strategic partner.

slots.title: Understand why now matters most
slots.body: Timing drives decisions. Discover what sparked their search today. Understanding urgency helps you tailor the timeline and accelerate the deal.

slots.title: Learn from their past attempts
slots.body: Previous solutions reveal gaps and frustrations. Listen closely to what disappointed them. Your offer becomes the clear alternative they have been missing.

slots.title: Map the full buying committee
slots.body: Selling to one person risks silent objections later. Map out stakeholders early. This prepares you to address diverse concerns before the final pitch.

slots.title: Clarify the investment upfront
slots.body: Budget discussions prevent wasted time for both sides. Be direct but respectful about investment. Qualification now means a smoother close later.

slots.title: Reveal the cost of inaction
slots.body: Status quo is often your biggest competitor. Highlight the risks of staying still. This builds emotional momentum toward choosing your solution.

slots.headline: Run calls that close
slots.body: Steal these six questions for your next discovery call. Better conversations start with better questions.
